_comment: EXAMPLE workspace.json — copy to your FlintTrade home and edit.
Locations: Linux ~/.flinttrade/workspace.json | macOS ~/Library/Application Support/flinttrade/workspace.json | Windows %APPDATA%/flinttrade/workspace.json (override with FLINTTRADE_HOME).
This file is user PREFERENCES only. Infrastructure (OpenAlgo host/ports) lives in .env; hardened secrets live as ACL-locked files under your FlintTrade home — never here.
Secrets are NEVER stored in plaintext: *_ref fields name a keyring/env entry that is resolved at runtime. Leave them empty or point them at a reference; never paste a real token.

FlintTrade writes this file with sorted keys on save, and creates it from defaults on first run — you usually do not need to hand-write it. The _comment keys are ignored by the config reader and safe to keep or delete.
British spelling in any prose you add. Never commit your real workspace.json (it is gitignored).

brokers._comment: Broker wiring. 'openalgo:default' is the built-in OpenAlgo-compatible bridge. Register additional native gateway adapters by id, then route execution and each data feed to one of them. account_acls maps a broker account id to the actor allowed to use it.

rate_limits._comment: Optional per-broker API rate-limit overrides in requests/sec. Keys are broker ids (e.g. 'dhan:main'), each mapping to { "order": N, "data": M }. Omitted brokers/keys fall back to the adapter's built-in capability defaults; 0 means unlimited. Example: "dhan:main": { "order": 8, "data": 4 }.

smart_routing._comment: Liquidity-aware order slicing (POST /api/v1/orders/smart-route + the Smart Order widget). OFF by default; live mode only. Every child order still traverses the full gated execution path. twap_window_seconds/twap_slices tune low-urgency TWAP.

compliance._comment: Legacy workspace section for personal-use safety defaults. personal_use_mode true keeps FlintTrade in the single-user posture. ai_disclosure_banner shows the 'AI output is not investment advice' notice. static_ip is an optional, non-secret label for your own records — leave empty.

autonomous_agent._comment: The LLM-driven order-workflow agent (AI route → Agent panel; /api/v1/ai/agent/*). OFF by default — it can place real orders in live mode. Enabling it also requires granting the 'autonomous-trader' actor access in brokers.account_acls; every agent order still traverses the full gated execution path.

llm._comment: Optional local or hosted LLM. provider/host/model are non-secret. api_key_ref names a keyring/env entry (e.g. 'env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') — never paste a real key here.

modules._comment: Toggle optional subsystems. terminal/dashboard/screener/backtest are on by default; ai/ditto/automation are off until you opt in.

notifications._comment: Telegram alerts are optional and off by default. telegram_bot_token_ref names a keyring/env entry — never paste the real bot token here. telegram_chat_id is your own chat id.

openalgo._comment: Mirror of the optional OpenAlgo-compatible bridge. The authoritative connection settings are in .env (OPENALGO_HOST / OPENALGO_PORT / OPENALGO_WS_PORT). Loopback placeholders shown.

sebi._comment: Local safety limits (personal use). max_ops_per_second throttles order operations; audit_retention_years keeps the local audit log; kill_switch_enabled arms the engine kill switch.

storage._comment: Data directories. Defaults sit under your FlintTrade home; override with absolute paths or a leading ~ if you keep data elsewhere.

ui._comment: Display preferences. theme is 'dark' or 'light'; default_exchange and timezone suit an Indian-market setup out of the box.
